layerContract.cameraConvention: Orthographic camera on negative Z looking toward +Z. Confirm actual projection/near-far planes; positive Z in this contract is farther away. Use explicit sorting regardless of Z.
layerContract.pausePolicy: Visual-only background drift; host pause may freeze it. No movement/cost/device logic from background clock.
layerContract.centralBoardProtection: Place distant islands and framing arches outside the board/camera-safe rectangle; cloud drift clips/wraps outside board and cannot obscure devices.
